title: Quantum Diffusion in the Anderson Model
exact_target: Show that a particle in the conducting regime of the Anderson model spreads diffusively.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 7900003 (AMR-078-0003). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
Barry Simon, Schrödinger operators in the twenty-first century, Mathematical Physics 2000, pp. 283–288, original Problem 3.
Wikipedia contributors, Simon problems, pinned revision 1335881350, The 2000 list. Existing catalogue wording adapted; CC BY-SA 4.0.

status_qualification: The statement is conditional on a regime with absolutely continuous spectrum, whose existence is a related problem. The catalogue does not specify whether the asymptotic is almost sure, averaged over disorder, or energy-restricted; that ambiguity is retained rather than replaced by one stronger assertion.
